why_botia: BOTIA flags an explicit declaration because the FDA currently lists this colour for specified U.S. uses while also placing the remaining petroleum-derived certified colours in a current risk-management/voluntary phase-out initiative. Review or phase-out activity is not itself proof that a declared amount in an individual product causes harm.
